segments.text: What: A complete, self-paced curriculum for reaching system-design interview mastery in 180 days at 3 hours/day (540 hours total), ending in 20 scored mock interviews.
How to complete: Work top to bottom: Day 0 setup, then Phases 1–9 in strict order (each gates the next), running the 3 parallel tracks every week throughout.
Legend: ⭐ = your existing strength (rehearse articulation, don't re-learn) · 🎯 = scored mock interview · 🔑 = phase gate.
